But app and cms returned 200 via the proxy right before that... unless the dev servers were listening but ss's output was just empty due to some quirk. In fact, earlier when I checked "=== port check (all) ===" it was also empty, yet the app/cms HTTP 200 was working. So either `ss -tln` isn't showing them (weird), or the earlier 200s came from servers that are now dead.

Let me wait for boards to build, then re-verify all three again, and also check with a direct localhost curl.
